scope: Pre-implementation read-only requirements/design/tasks review against REQUEST.md; not task approval or product execution acceptance

coverage.request_mapping: REQ-001 through REQ-008 and T-001 cover all requested behavior, README, CLI unittest, actual Red before application and retained Green
coverage.counting: One recursive traversal counts actual testcase nodes; suite aggregate attributes ignored; direct-child outcome precedence error > failure > skipped > passed
coverage.namespace: XML local names for roots, testcase and direct outcome children; default/prefixed namespace fixtures required
coverage.exit_and_output: 0 passing/skipped/empty; 1 failures/errors; 2 invalid/no-input; output delayed until all files parse; no traceback/partial stdout; help exception explicit
coverage.input_preservation: Read-only binary XML parsing plus before/after bytes tests on valid and invalid runs
coverage.ambiguities: Duplicate paths count as supplied reports; compact ordered JSON with newline; unknown children ignored; these explicit conventions are compatible with REQUEST

nonblocking_notes.recommendation: Include an unknown XML encoding declaration negative fixture and classify its expected parser exception as exit2/no traceback/no stdout. ElementTree may raise LookupError rather than ParseError; the current design general requirement already covers malformed inputs, but ordinary malformed-tag tests alone would miss this case.

limitations: No application exists or was executed during this review.
No approval, token, signature, task state or specification file changed.
Native hook/intake observations quoted by design were not re-evaluated; they are not CLI acceptance evidence.
